definitions.explanation: Words expressing weakness, discouragement, or a desire to give up. Almost always used in the set phrase {弱音|よわね}を{吐|は}く (to complain, to whine).

examples.japanese: {弱音|よわね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧な。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{弱音|よわね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}かなかった→吐く：04397_haku⟧。
つらい{時|とき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{弱音|よわね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}いて→吐く：04397_haku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧んだ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: A friend told me it's okay to let out your feelings when things are tough.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost exclusively appears in the phrase {弱音|よわね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧ (to whine, to show weakness). Traditionally viewed negatively, as showing weakness is often discouraged in Japanese culture. However, in modern usage, people also say {弱音|よわね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}いて→吐く：04397_haku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (it's okay to express your struggles).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弱音|よわね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧ (to whine, to complain)
- {弱音|よわね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}かない→吐く：04397_haku⟧ (to not show weakness)
- {弱音|よわね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}いて→吐く：04397_haku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (it's okay to express weakness)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{愚痴|ぐち}→愚痴：06623_guchi⟧: complaints about everyday frustrations — less about weakness, more about venting
- ⟦{泣|な}き{言|ごと}→泣き言：15899_nakigoto⟧: tearful complaints — similar to {弱音|よわね} but emphasizes emotional distress
